drafted_from: tool:make-a-sound-effect-palette row in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/tool-rows.json, its script in tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/ and tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (run for real on made-up tones)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Render my sound-effect palette from /work/sfx/PALETTE.json with sources under /work/sfx into /work/sfx/palette and check each sound by ear." It runs the palette maker and reads back each finished sound.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list: it reads PALETTE.json and source sound files on this computer and writes WAV files and palette_readings.json into the folder it is given.
instructions: 1. Write /work/sfx/PALETTE.json: rate, channels, fade_in_s, fade_out_s, peak_dbfs and sounds [{name, src, trim [start, end] in seconds, query, manifest}] with each src relative to the root folder.

2. Say "Make my palette". The AI reads the row with tools:list and runs: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 <earshot python> -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/make_sound_palette.py /work/sfx/PALETTE.json /work/sfx /work/sfx/palette
3. Read the last line, then open palette_readings.json: each sound has its seconds, final match z, verdict, describe, realness and loudness.
4. Run tool:check-a-sound-effect-palette on the folder to check format, edges and licences.

worked_examples.title: Cut a 0.6 s trim of one source into a 48 kHz stereo palette sound
worked_examples.ask: Render my palette and read each sound back.
worked_examples.given: From tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/test/test_judge_sound_effects.py (test_made_palette_passes_its_check_and_an_unlicensed_or_short_one_fails, stand-in earshot): PALETTE.json has rate 48000, channels 2, fade_in_s 0.005, fade_out_s 0.02, peak_dbfs -6.0 and one sound {"name": "hit", "src": "hits/a.wav", "trim": [0.05, 0.65], "query": "a low hit", "manifest": "lib-1"}. Command: EARSHOT_THREADS=3 python -I tools/generate-and-judge-sound-effects/do-work/make_sound_palette.py /work/sfx/PALETTE.json /work/sfx /work/sfx/palette
worked_examples.hands_back: Last line: {"result": {"out": "/work/sfx/palette", "sounds": 1, "readings": "/work/sfx/palette/palette_readings.json"}}. /work/sfx/palette/hit.wav is 48000 Hz x2, 24-bit, peak -6.0 dBFS; palette_readings.json has hit with seconds 0.6, final_match_z 3.0, final_verdict "matches", final_describe "a tone near 200 Hz", final_lufs -9.8.
